persona.backstory: Ide Fenwick has kept the watch-house at Greyholt for thirty winters, lighting the lamp, logging who came over the moor and who did not. She has asked to go down to the valley, and the new watch has come up the road to relieve her.
persona.demeanor: Brisk, weathered, fond of the place and impatient to be gone before she changes her mind.
persona.motivation: Hand the post over properly, with its sword, and walk down the road before dark.
persona.speech_style: Short and practical, a watch-keeper used to giving orders in wind. Calls the watch-house the post and the moor the top.
